# Testing the inter-species hourglass model

Statistically test whether the two cell lineages (fusiform & ray lineages) share higher transcriptomic similarity at mid developmental stage.

## Setup

```{r Library}
library(Seurat, quietly = TRUE)
library(slingshot, quietly = TRUE)
library(dtw, quietly = TRUE)
library(sccore, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr, quietly = TRUE)
library(Matrix, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)
library(pheatmap, quietly = TRUE)
library(foreach, quietly = TRUE)
library(doSNOW, quietly = TRUE)
source("notebooks/scripts/hourglass_analysis.R")
source("notebooks/scripts/parallel_processing.R")
```

## Single-copy orthogroups

Compare the fusiform-to-fiber and fusiform-to-vessel trajectories between species, separately. Keep exactly one locus per focal species **before** intersecting with expression features. By default, this applies the supplied four-species criterion (`PoT`, `EuG`, `LiC`, `TrA`), not only the two-species criterion.

```{r Read single-copy orthogroups}
orth <- read.csv(
  orthogroup_table,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
stopifnot(all(c("cluster_id", "species_name", "gene_name") %in% names(orth)))

# 
orth_focal <- orth %>%
  dplyr::filter(species_name %in% focal_species) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(cluster_id, species_name, gene_name)
if (
  nrow(orth_focal) == 0L || anyNA(orth_focal) ||
  any(!nzchar(orth_focal$cluster_id)) || any(!nzchar(orth_focal$gene_name))
) {
  stop("The focal-species orthogroup memberships are empty or contain missing IDs.")
}

orth_copy_number <- orth_focal %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_id, species_name, name = "n_loci") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    cluster_id,
    species_name = focal_species,
    fill = list(n_loci = 0L)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = species_name, values_from = n_loci)

single_copy_groups <- orth_copy_number[
  rowSums(as.matrix(orth_copy_number[, focal_species, drop = FALSE]) == 1L) ==
    length(focal_species),
  "cluster_id", drop = FALSE
]

# 
orth_single_copy <- orth_focal %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(single_copy_groups, by = "cluster_id") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = cluster_id,
    names_from = species_name,
    values_from = gene_name
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_id)

for (sp in names(species_codes)) {
  names(orth_single_copy)[names(orth_single_copy) == species_codes[[sp]]] <- sp
}
if (nrow(orth_single_copy) < 2L) {
  stop("Fewer than two single-copy orthogroups passed the focal-species criterion.")
}
for (sp in c(species_1, species_2)) {
  if (anyDuplicated(orth_single_copy[[sp]])) {
    stop("A ", sp, " gene is assigned to more than one retained orthogroup.")
  }
}

dim(orth_single_copy)
head(orth_single_copy)
```

Helper functions

```{r Define helper functions}
# Native gene IDs remain in each Seurat object for independent PCA/Slingshot.
# Only cross-species expression comparisons use aligned orthogroup IDs.
orthogroup_expression <- function(pb, orth_expression, species_name) {
  ids <- orth_expression[[species_name]]
  if (!all(ids %in% rownames(pb))) {
    stop("Some retained ", species, " genes are absent from the pseudobulk matrix.")
  }
  out <- pb[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- orth_expression$cluster_id
  out
}
preprocess_seurat <- function(object) {
  object <- NormalizeData(object, verbose = FALSE)
  object <- FindVariableFeatures(object, verbose = FALSE)
  object <- ScaleData(object, features = VariableFeatures(object), verbose = FALSE)
  RunPCA(object, npcs = 30, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
}
```

## Seurat preprocessing

```{r CreateSeuratObject}
read_sample <- function(path, sample_id) {
  counts <- Read10X_h5(path)
  if (is.list(counts)) {
    if (!"Gene Expression" %in% names(counts)) {
      stop("No Gene Expression matrix was found for ", sample_id)
    }
    counts <- counts[["Gene Expression"]]
  }
  CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = sample_id)
}
seurat_obj_1 <- read_sample(path_mtx_1, params$sample_id_1)
seurat_obj_2 <- read_sample(path_mtx_2, params$sample_id_2)
seurat_obj_1
seurat_obj_2
```

Import UMAP

```{r Import UMAP}
import_umap <- function(object, path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(object)
  emb <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(
    all(c("Barcode", "UMAP.1", "UMAP.2") %in% names(emb)),
    !anyDuplicated(emb$Barcode),
    all(Cells(object) %in% emb$Barcode)
  )
  rownames(emb) <- emb$Barcode
  emb <- as.matrix(emb[Cells(object), c("UMAP.1", "UMAP.2"), drop = FALSE])
  object[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = emb, key = "UMAP_", global = TRUE,
    assay = DefaultAssay(object)
  )
  object
}
seurat_obj_1 <- import_umap(seurat_obj_1, path_umap_1)
seurat_obj_2 <- import_umap(seurat_obj_2, path_umap_2)

plot_reduction_2 <- if ("umap" %in% Reductions(seurat_obj_2)) "umap" else "pca"
```

Match single-copy genes to both count matrices. Gene IDs must match exactly; transcript/version suffixes are not removed automatically. similarity_discrete <- calculate_similarity(

```{r Discrete stages hourlgass}
  metrics = params$metric

  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,

                 species_1, species_2, params$metric)
)
```

## Test hourglass along pseudotime

**The procedure:**

1.  Infer fusiform pseudotime independently in each species using Slingshot based on its own PCA coordinates.

2.  Aggregate expression by pseudotime bins (by `n_bins`).

3.  Calculate pairwise similarity between species within each fusiform branch using matched single-copy orthogroups (using `metric`).

4.  Align the corresponding species-specific branches by Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), using `window_dtw`. Species 1 is the query; species 2 is the reference.

5.  Calculate the `hourglass score` based on cell lineage alignment.

    Hourglass score is defined as follows:

    Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

    $$
    E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
    M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
    L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
    $$

    The hourglass score was then defined as

    $$
    H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
    $$

    A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

6.  Permutation for the null distribution of the hourglass score\

    (1) Shuffle pseudotime values\
    (2) Repeat Step 2-5\
    (3) Estimate permutation p-value

7.  Bootstrapping for the confidence interval of the hourglass score\

    (1) Re-sample cells with replacement\
    (2) Repeat Step 1-5\
    (3) Estimate bootstrap confidence interval

### 1. Pseudotime inference

Infer Pseudotime based on PCA coordinates

```{r Infer Pseudotime}
slingshot_res_1 <- slingshot_manual(seurat_obj_1, lineage_cell_types)
slingshot_res_2 <- slingshot_manual(seurat_obj_2, lineage_cell_types)
pseudotime_1 <- slingshot_res_1$pseudotime
pseudotime_2 <- slingshot_res_2$pseudotime
branch_id_1 <- slingshot_res_1$branch_id
branch_id_2 <- slingshot_res_2$branch_id
head(pseudotime_1)
head(pseudotime_2)
```

#### Plot Pseudotime

```{r Plot Pseudotime}
plot_pseudotime <- function(object, result, reduction) {
  prob <- slingCurveWeights(result$SlingshotDataSet, as.probs = TRUE)
  pt <- result$pseudotime
  prob[!is.finite(pt)] <- 0
  pt[!is.finite(pt)] <- 0
  totals <- rowSums(prob)
  object$pseudotime_all <- ifelse(totals > 0, rowSums(pt * prob) / totals, NA_real_)
  FeaturePlot(object, features = "pseudotime_all", reduction = reduction) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1, option = "magma") +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = Project(object))
}
p_pt_1 <- plot_pseudotime(seurat_obj_1, slingshot_res_1, plot_reduction_1)
p_pt_2 <- plot_pseudotime(seurat_obj_2, slingshot_res_2, plot_reduction_2)
p_pt_1 | p_pt_2
```

### 2. Bin expression by pseudotime

Expression was aggregated within equal-width pseudotime bins independently for each lineage.

Corresponding fusiform branches from the two species were subsequently aligned using a constrained monotonic DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) path.

```{r Bin expression}
n_bins <- as.integer(params$n_bins)
res_L1_1 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj_1, 
  pseudotime_1, 
  branch_id_1,
  lineage = 1, 
  n_bins = n_bins, 
  prefix = paste0(species_1, "-Fiber")
)
res_L1_2 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj_2, 
  pseudotime_2, 
  branch_id_2,
  lineage = 1, 
  n_bins = n_bins, 
  prefix = paste0(species_2, "-Fiber")
)
pb_L1_1 <- orthogroup_expression(res_L1_1$Pseudobulk, orth_expression, species_1)
pb_L1_2 <- orthogroup_expression(res_L1_2$Pseudobulk, orth_expression, species_2)
comp_L1_1 <- res_L1_1$Composition
comp_L1_2 <- res_L1_2$Composition
```

Check bin composition

```{r Check bin composition}
# Cell counts
composition <- rbind(
  transform(as.data.frame(comp_L1_1), lineage = "Fiber", species = species_1),

)

composition$bin <- factor(composition$bin, levels = 1:n_bins)
composition$cell_type <- factor(composition$cell_type, levels = cluster_levels)
```

```{r Plot DTW path}
plot_dtw_path <- function(
  similarity,
  aligned,
  title
) {
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)

  stopifnot(
    max(aligned$path$L1_i) <= nrow(similarity),
    max(aligned$path$L2_i) <= ncol(similarity)
  )

  heatmap_data <- expand.grid(
    L1_i = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
    L2_i = seq_len(ncol(similarity))
  )

  heatmap_data$similarity <- similarity[
    cbind(
      heatmap_data$L1_i,
      heatmap_data$L2_i
    )
  ]

  ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = L2_i,
      y = L1_i,
      fill = similarity
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_path(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlBu", 
      direction = -1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(ncol(similarity)),
      labels = colnames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse(
      breaks = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
      labels = rownames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste(species_2, "reference bin"),
      y = paste(species_1, "query bin"),
      fill = "similarity",
      title = title
    )
}
```

### 5. Calculate hourglass score

Hourglass score is defined as follows:

Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

$$
E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
$$

The hourglass score was then defined as

$$
H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
$$

A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

```{r Define function for calculating hourglass scores}
print(hourglass_score)
```

```{r Calculate the hourglass score}
scores_observed <- rbind(
  hourglass_score(aligned_L1$path, modules)
) %>% 
  as.data.frame %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    comparison = c("Fiber-Fiber"),
    permutation = "Observed"
  )

scores_observed
```

Calculate the permutation p-value

```{r Calculate the permutation p-value}
observed_H <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_obs = H
  )

permutation_results <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(H)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H_perm = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_H,
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_obs = dplyr::first(H_obs),
    n_permutation = dplyr::n_distinct(permutation),
    n_null_ge_observed = sum(H_perm >= dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    null_mean = mean(H_perm),
    null_median = median(H_perm),
    null_sd = stats::sd(H_perm),
    null_q025 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.025)),
    null_q95 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.95)),
    null_q975 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.975)),
    observed_minus_null_mean = dplyr::first(H_obs) - mean(H_perm),
    observed_percentile = mean(H_perm < dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # One-sided empirical permutation P value
    p_empirical = (n_null_ge_observed + 1) / (n_permutation + 1),
    # Adjust p-value
    p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_empirical, method = "holm")
  )

permutation_results
```

### 7. Bootstrapping

```{r Define bootstrapping helper functions}
run_bootstrap_once <- function(seed) {
  on.exit(gc(), add = TRUE)
  tryCatch({
    # set random seed
    set.seed(seed)
    
    # random seed for two samples
    sample_seeds <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 2L)
    
    # re-sample
    objects_i <- list(
      make_bootstrap_seurat(seurat_obj_1, sample_seeds[1])$object,
      make_bootstrap_seurat(seurat_obj_2, sample_seeds[2])$object
    )
    objects_i <- lapply(objects_i, preprocess_seurat)
    
    # pseudotime
    slingshot_i <- lapply(objects_i, slingshot_manual, lineage_cell_types)
    
    # bin expression
    query <- bin_expression(
      objects_i[[1]], 
      slingshot_i[[1]]$pseudotime, 
      slingshot_i[[1]]$branch_id,
      lineage = 1, 
      n_bins = n_bins,
      prefix = paste0(species_1, "-Fiber")
    )
    reference <- bin_expression(
      objects_i[[2]], 
      slingshot_i[[2]]$pseudotime, 
      slingshot_i[[2]]$branch_id,
      lineage = 1, 
      n_bins = n_bins,
      prefix = paste0(species_2, "-Fiber")
    )
    
    # identify middle stage module
    modules_i <- get_middle_module(
      pb_mat = query$Pseudobulk, 
      comp = query$Composition,
      cell_types = "Fusiform Early Precursor",
      cell_type_marker = species_marker,
      weight_by_prop = TRUE,
      n_bins = params$window_mid,
      norm_func = logcpm
    )
    
    # convert pseudobulk matrix to single-copy orthogroup expression
    query_pb <- orthogroup_expression(
      query$Pseudobulk, 
      orth_expression, 
      species_1
    )
    reference_pb <- orthogroup_expression(
      reference$Pseudobulk, 
      orth_expression, 
      species_2
    )
    
    # calculate similarity
    similarity <- calculate_similarity(
      reference_pb, 
      query_pb, 
      metric
    )
    
    # align bins
    aligned <- align_similarity_matrix(
      t(similarity), 
      ceiling(params$window_dtw * max(dim(similarity))),
      open.begin = params$open.begin,
      open.end = params$open.end
    )
    
    # hourglass score
    score_i <- hourglass_score(aligned$path, modules_i)
    
    # alignment mass
    mass_i <- alignment_label_mass(
      aligned, query$Composition, reference$Composition,
      lineage_cell_types[[1]], lineage_cell_types[[1]]
    )

    # return
    list(
      ok = TRUE, seed = seed,
      scores = data.frame(
        rbind(score_i), 
        comparison = comparison_names,
        bootstrap = seed, 
        row.names = NULL, 
        check.names = FALSE
      ),
      alignment_mass = mass_i, error = NA_character_
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(ok = FALSE, seed = seed, scores = NULL,
         alignment_mass = NULL, error = conditionMessage(e))
  })
}
```

```{r}
summarize_alignment_mass <- function(
    bootstrap_output,
    bootstrap_ok,
    comparison
) {
  mass_list <- lapply(
    bootstrap_output[bootstrap_ok],
    function(x) {
      x$alignment_mass
    }
  )

  mass_array <- simplify2array(mass_list)

  list(
    mean = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), mean),
    median = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), median),
    lower = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(mass_array,c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.975),
    array = mass_array
  )
}
```

#### Calculate confidence interval

```{r Calculate confidence interval}
scores_observed_ci <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

scores_bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap_ci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::n_distinct(bootstrap),

    H_median = median(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    H_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_E_median = median(M_minus_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_E_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_E_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_L_median = median(M_minus_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_L_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_L_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scores_observed_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_observed = H,
        M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
        M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_observed,
    H_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_E_ci_lower,
    M_minus_E_ci_upper,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    M_minus_L_ci_lower,
    M_minus_L_ci_upper,
    n_bootstrap
  )

bootstrap_ci
```

#### Plot bootstrap hourglass scores

```{r Plot bootstrap hourglass scores}
p_bootstrap_H <- ggplot(
  scores_bootstrap,
  aes(x = H)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = scores_observed,
    aes(xintercept = H),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Bootstrap H",
    y = "Counts",
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = sprintf("Observed H: %.2f", scores_observed$H),

  )
p_bootstrap_H
```

## Write key data

Write one long CSV containing the observed scores and the complete permutation and bootstrap distributions. Both species are recorded explicitly; the legacy `sample_id` and `individual_id` fields identify the pair. A downstream biological-replicate analysis must account for any samples reused across pairs.

```{r Prepare key data}
pair_metadata <- list(
  sample_id_1 = as.character(params$sample_id_1),
  sample_id_2 = as.character(params$sample_id_2),
  species_1 = species_1,
  species_2 = species_2,
  individual_id_1 = params$individual_id_1,
  individual_id_2 = params$individual_id_2,
  condition_1 = params$condition_1,
  condition_2 = params$condition_2,
  batch_1 = params$batch_1,
  batch_2 = params$batch_2
)
sample_metadata <- list(
  sample_id = paste(pair_metadata$sample_id_1, pair_metadata$sample_id_2, sep = "__vs__"),
  individual_id = paste(pair_metadata$individual_id_1, pair_metadata$individual_id_2, sep = "__vs__"),
  condition = paste(pair_metadata$condition_1, pair_metadata$condition_2, sep = "__vs__"),
  batch = paste(pair_metadata$batch_1, pair_metadata$batch_2, sep = "__vs__")
)

observed_key <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "observed",
    replicate_id = "Observed",
    seed = NA_integer_,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

permutation_key <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "permutation",
    replicate_id = permutation,
    seed = as.integer(seed),
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

bootstrap_key <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    data_type = "bootstrap",
    replicate_id = paste0("Bootstrap-", bootstrap),
    seed = as.integer(bootstrap),
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H
  )

key_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  observed_key,
  permutation_key,
  bootstrap_key,
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = sample_metadata$sample_id,
    individual_id = sample_metadata$individual_id,
    condition = sample_metadata$condition,
    batch = sample_metadata$batch,
    !!!pair_metadata,
    focal_species = paste(focal_species, collapse = ","),
    middle_cell_types = paste(middle_cell_types, collapse = ";"),
    middle_fraction = middle_fraction,
    query_species = species_1,
    metric = as.character(params$metric),
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late,
    n_cells = ncol(seurat_obj_1) + ncol(seurat_obj_2),
    n_cells_1 = ncol(seurat_obj_1),
    n_cells_2 = ncol(seurat_obj_2),
    n_genes = length(genes), # Legacy column: the number of orthogroups.
    n_orthogroups = length(genes),
    n_bins = n_bins,
    n_permutation = n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested = n_bootstrap,
    n_bootstrap_valid = sum(bootstrap_ok),
    n_bootstrap_failed = sum(!bootstrap_ok)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    individual_id,
    condition,
    batch,
    dplyr::all_of(names(pair_metadata)),
    focal_species, middle_cell_types, middle_fraction, query_species,
    metric,
    data_type,
    replicate_id,
    seed,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    M_minus_E,
    M_minus_L,
    H,
    n_cells, n_cells_1, n_cells_2,
    n_genes, n_orthogroups,
    n_bins,
    n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested,
    n_bootstrap_valid,
    n_bootstrap_failed
  )

head(key_data)
```

Write a concise sample-pair summary in addition to the complete long table.

```{r Prepare key summary}
branch_key_summary <- scores_observed_ci %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    H_observed = H,
    M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
    M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    permutation_results %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        p_permutation = p_empirical,
        p_holm,
        null_mean,
        null_sd
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    bootstrap_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_bootstrap_median = H_median,
        H_ci_lower,
        H_ci_upper,
        n_bootstrap
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  )


key_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  branch_key_summary,
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = sample_metadata$sample_id,
    individual_id = sample_metadata$individual_id,
    condition = sample_metadata$condition,
    batch = sample_metadata$batch,
    !!!pair_metadata,
    focal_species = paste(focal_species, collapse = ","),
    middle_cell_types = paste(middle_cell_types, collapse = ";"),
    middle_fraction = middle_fraction,
    query_species = species_1,
    metric = as.character(params$metric),
    n_cells = ncol(seurat_obj_1) + ncol(seurat_obj_2),
    n_cells_1 = ncol(seurat_obj_1),
    n_cells_2 = ncol(seurat_obj_2),
    n_genes = length(genes), # Legacy column: the number of orthogroups.
    n_orthogroups = length(genes),
    n_bins = n_bins,
    n_permutation = n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested = n_bootstrap,
    n_bootstrap_valid = sum(bootstrap_ok),
    n_bootstrap_failed = sum(!bootstrap_ok)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    individual_id,
    condition,
    batch,
    dplyr::all_of(names(pair_metadata)),
    focal_species, middle_cell_types, middle_fraction, query_species,
    metric,
    comparison,
    Early,
    Middle,
    Late,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    H_observed,
    p_permutation,
    p_holm,
    null_mean,
    null_sd,
    H_bootstrap_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    n_cells, n_cells_1, n_cells_2,
    n_genes, n_orthogroups,
    n_bins,
    n_permutation,
    n_bootstrap_requested,
    n_bootstrap_valid,
    n_bootstrap_failed
  )

key_summary
```

```{r Write key data CSVs}
dir.create(

  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)
dir.create(
  dirname(params$path_key_summary),

)

)

)

  dirname(params$path_key_summary),

)
write.csv(orth_expression, path_orthogroups_used, row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
```
